rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese way to mean the specific thing or entity that a word refers to.

example.english: When you say “apple,” the referent can be the fruit or the company.
example.traditional: 你講「蘋果」呢個字嗰陣，所指嘅嘢可以係生果，亦可以係嗰間公司。
